Title: Successful login with valid corporate credentials and valid TOTP MFA code
Preconditions: User account exists with email 'alice@enterprise.corp' and status 'Active'; Two-factor authentication is configured and enabled for user
Steps:
1. Navigate to https://portal.enterprise.corp/login
2. Enter 'alice@enterprise.corp' into email field
3. Enter valid password into password field and click 'Sign In'
4. Observe redirect to MFA challenge page
5. Generate fresh TOTP from authenticator and enter into 6-digit input
6. Click 'Verify & Continue'
Expected Result: Session established; user redirected to /dashboard with greeting 'Welcome, Alice'

Title: Authentication denied when password is incorrect
Preconditions: User account exists and is not locked
Steps:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Enter 'alice@enterprise.corp' and invalid password 'WrongPass!123'
3. Click 'Sign In'
Expected Result: Error alert 'Invalid credentials' displayed; MFA prompt is not displayed; failed attempt count increments

Title: Rejection of expired or previously consumed TOTP token
Preconditions: User has submitted valid primary credentials and is on MFA prompt screen; TOTP token '123456' has already been consumed or its 30s window has expired
Steps:
1. Enter expired TOTP '123456' into code input
2. Click 'Verify & Continue'
Expected Result: Inline validation error 'Invalid or expired code. Please enter the current code from your authenticator' displayed

Title: Account lockout triggered upon 5 consecutive failed login attempts
Preconditions: User account has 4 recorded failed attempts within the past 10 minutes
Steps:
1. Enter 'alice@enterprise.corp' with 5th incorrect password
2. Click 'Sign In'
Expected Result: Account locked banner displayed: 'Your account has been temporarily locked for 15 minutes due to multiple failed attempts'; subsequent valid login attempts are rejected during lockout

Title: Mask and unmask password toggle interaction
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1. Enter 'SuperSecretP@ss1' in password input
2. Verify input type is 'password'
3. Click eye / toggle icon
4. Verify input type changes to 'text' and password characters are visible
5. Click toggle icon again
Expected Result: Input field toggles dynamically between type='text' and type='password'
